Reason: The CT images demonstrate innumerable, tiny (micronodular) opacities distributed randomly throughout all lung fields, which is the hallmark radiological finding of miliary tuberculosis. This random distribution distinguishes it from perilymphatic or centrilobular patterns and fits the classic description of hematogenous spread seen in miliary disease.
